gaps.name: authorized-resource-production-adapters
gaps.description: Asset/font/style resolver ports and deterministic contracts are implemented, but production Asset Service authorization, signed preview/full URLs, font entitlement, and resource-version lookup are not wired in this node.

gaps.name: node15-artifact-provenance-persistence
gaps.description: Every successful compile emits compiler_version plus document/scene/resource/font/token provenance and exposes an Artifact provenance sink, but the durable NODE-15 persistence adapter is not wired here.

gaps.name: browser-export-font-metric-conformance
gaps.description: Font invalidation and deterministic fallback measurement are implemented; real browser font loading, cross-browser metric snapshots, and export-server controlled-font parity still require browser/server integration evidence.

gaps.name: pixi-v8-browser-materialization
gaps.description: CompiledScene and incremental patches bridge into the NODE-40 renderer-neutral contract and an executable renderer runtime, but the inherited pinned PixiJS v8 browser binding remains open until NODE-40 K40-G01 is closed.

gaps.name: standard-hardware-compiler-performance-gate
gaps.description: Local 2k/10k reference measurements exist, but release budgets must be calibrated and enforced on the NODE-08 standard browser/hardware profile rather than inferred from the current isolated container.
